title: K-HATERS: A Hate Speech Detection Corpus in Korean with Target-Specific Ratings
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hate speech and offensive language targeting religious groups in Korean news comments.
findings: A case study found that in news comments on politics and world events, hate speech was frequently targeted toward politics and religion.
